text_block_list.text:
I watch a luxurious-looking car drive 
away. It appears to be the private 
chauffeur car of Daiichi Ruby's family.

While I was helping an elderly lady from a 
traditional Japanese sweet shop who had 
tripped, Daiichi Ruby happened to pass by 
and gave us a ride to the shop!

text_block_list.name: Sweet Shop Granny
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly grateful for your help. But with 
things like this, it looks like I won't be 
able to open the shop today...

Hearing those words, Daiichi Ruby looks at 
the flyer posted on the shop door. "50th 
Anniversary Commemorative Sale"... The 
date is today.

text_block_list.name: Sweet Shop Granny
text_block_list.text:
So many customers were supposed to come 
too... I'm going to disappoint them all...

Outside the shop, people are indeed 
starting to gather. It seems to be a 
deeply beloved store...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Shopkeeper, could you please select a 
few of your usual best-sellers? 
Trainer-san, my apologies, but please head 
to the bank.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, there is a risk that we will 
run out of change relative to the expected 
customer turnout.

Getting change at the bank was fine, but I 
gradually grew worried. Right now, only 
Daiichi Ruby and the elderly shopkeeper 
are at the store—
choice_data_list: Can Ruby really manage a storefront?!

Can Ruby really manage a storefront, I 
wonder?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ruby minding a store? Now that sounds like 
an interesting conversation.

One of Tracen Academy's most prominent 
free spirits, Mr. C.B. When I explain the 
circumstances and the reason for my 
anxiety—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, nice! I kinda wanna see that 
ojou-sama minding a shop!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, but then again... it probably won't 
be that funny after all. There's no way 
that girl would ever attempt something she 
couldn't handle.

Mr. C.B. said that, but I'm still 
worried... Thinking this over, I return to 
the sweet shop alone.

Were the two of them able to run the shop? 
Looking inside, I see Daiichi Ruby 
operating the cash register in place of 
the granny. And next to her—

text_block_list.name: Energetic Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text: Welcome, welcome!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
He is a long-time regular of this shop. 
Upon checking the customer list and 
contacting him, he rushed over 
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Trend-Chasing Lady
text_block_list.text: What do you recommend here~?

text_block_list.name: Energetic Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the mame daifuku here has always been 
the absolute best! It's soft yet the red 
bean paste is rich and solid, and the 
saltiness of the beans is exquisite—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
He is extremely knowledgeable about this 
shop, so I requested his assistance with 
customer service. I shall handle the 
register and logistics.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...As expected, there are many first-time 
customers today... We should highlight 
affordable items that are easy to pick up. 
Please assist with rearranging the layout.
choice_data_list: Amazing, you're like a real store manager
Amazing, you're like a real store manager!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No. For a member of our clan, this is only 
natural.

Even as she said so while counting the 
stock of rice crackers, Daiichi Ruby 
somehow looked lively and in her element.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I came after all. Store clerk, one 
mame daifuku, please!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...C.B.-san.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
See? Exactly like I told you, right? 
Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: We were saved thanks to Ruby

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
See? Exactly like I told you, right? 
Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: We were saved thanks to Ruby

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Not particularly.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
How harsh~ We've seen each other plenty of 
times at those parties our parents dragged 
us to, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, unlike me, you always looked super 
busy... so it's true we hardly ever 
talked, though.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You're letting things go to waste as 
usual. It's like you take things that are 
fun and shave them down just to pack them 
into a rigid frame.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Here is your one mame daifuku. Thank 
you for waiting.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Aha, a mame daifuku handed over by you. 
What a rare treat. Thanks, see ya!

Even after Mr. C.B. left, Daiichi Ruby 
continued briskly carrying out the shop's 
duties.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I have set aside the rice crackers with 
noticeable cracks as defective items. 
Please carry them to the back room.

While carrying the rejected products away, 
I glance over at the display shelves 
Daiichi Ruby organized.

Impeccably neat, lined only with carefully 
selected, flawless products without a 
single imperfection or disruption— It 
truly looked perfect.

She truly took the shop's well-being into 
account, and the elderly lady was 
overjoyed... I praised Daiichi Ruby for 
her kindness.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, I had no such intention. I simply did 
what needed to be done.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, just like back then. You remember? 
When we were kids, at that party where 
that girl spilled juice on her skirt.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You even helped her change clothes... but 
when she thanked you, you brushed it off, 
saying, "I only did what was expected of 
our family."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I merely strive to act in a manner that 
never brings dishonor to the family name.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Just as I thought. Well, I don't 
think that's *all* there is to it, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll be heading out soon. 
Thanks for the mame daifuku!

Even after Mr. C.B. left, Daiichi Ruby 
continued briskly carrying out her work 
around the shop.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I have set aside these rice crackers with 
excessive cracks as defective items. 
Please take them to the back room.

While carrying the rejected goods, I 
glanced over at the display shelf Daiichi 
Ruby had organized.

Immaculately arranged with chosen items 
devoid of any chips or flaws— it looked, 
beyond a doubt, truly perfect.
